plugins.name: sessions
plugins.description: Side panel with this folder's Claude Code sessions: status colors, sections, one-window switching, stop, restart, rename, a waiting-for-you filter, auto-pin and reopen with Remote Control, a notification when a session waits too long or spends far above its usual, spend and token usage, a status line, ccc tell and ccc section for scripts, and an API for other plugins

plugins.name: fleet
plugins.description: Per project: background sessions ask you without stopping, and you answer from any session of the project with /fleet, at no token cost; shared files a session read and someone changed since are flagged to it, and its stale write is refused once. Needs sessions
